top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises the mature, independently confirmed discovery of GLP-1 physiology and its active form (Holst for human physiology, Drucker for receptor biology and the proglucagon-peptide axis, Mojsov for identification and synthesis of the active peptide) as a single-part prize, with the therapies as the demonstration. P002 is a defensible fallback that swaps in Knudsen and turns the citation toward development; Mojsov's priority record is contested and I cannot verify it from the files. Any B035 award is preferred to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile for the credited names; documented ties are to Ronald Evans, Johan Ericson, Per Svenningsson and Abdel El Manira, none of whom is a laureate in the slate
